question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

That which is no longer in existence
solution:
The correct answer is: **Extinct**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Extinct"** means something that is no longer in existence, having no living members. (विलुप्त)

 
 
• **Example: **Dinosaurs have been extinct for millions of years.
 
 
 
• **"Extinct" **refers to a species, family, or other larger group having no living members. (विलुप्त)
 
 
• **Example: **The dodo bird is an example of an extinct species.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the meaning of **'Extinct' **is **'no longer in existence'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Extinct**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Removed **(हटाया गया): Taken away or off from the position occupied.

 
 
• **Example:** The outdated files were removed from the system.
 
 
 
• **Vanished **(गायब हो गया ): Disappeared suddenly and completely.
 
 
• **Example: **The magician vanished into thin air.
 
 
 
• **Destroyed** (नष्ट किया गया): Put an end to the existence of (something) by damaging or attacking it.
 
 
• **Example:** The building was destroyed by the fire.
